g.text: Leaving Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center
WEST CAMPUS
1 Deaconess Road, Boston, MA 02215
To the North to Interstate 93, 95, and US 1:
From Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center West Campus, turn left onto Brookline Avenue.
Cross over Longwood Avenue and continue through two sets of lights. At the third set of lights
bear right onto Boylston Street.
Stay on Boylston Street and follow signs to Storrow Drive eastbound. Once on Storrow Drive follow
signs for Route 93, 95, and Route 1 North.
At Leverett Circle go up ramp and bear left to Route 93 North.
On Route 93 bear left for Route 95 and Route 1 or proceed straight for Route 93.
To the Northwest to Route 2:
From Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center West Campus, turn left onto Brookline Avenue.
Cross over Longwood Avenue and continue through two sets of lights. At the third set of lights
bear right onto Boylston Street.
Stay on Boylston Street and follow signs to Storrow Drive westbound. Stay on Storrow Drive and
follow the signs to Fresh Pond Parkway Route 2.
After crossing the Charles River, bear right and then left onto Fresh Pond Parkway.
Follow Fresh Pond Parkway to Route 2.
To the West to the Massachusetts Turnpike Extension:
From Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center West Campus, turn left onto Brookline Avenue.
Cross over Longwood Avenue and continue through two sets of lights.
At the third set of lights bear right onto Boylston Street. Continue on Boylston Street for 4 sets
of lights.
Bear right onto the downramp for Commonwealth Avenue. Off the downramp take a right onto
Commonwealth Avenue and stay in the right lane.
At the next set of lights, take a right onto Massachusetts Avenue and then a right onto the Massa-
chusetts Turnpike westbound ramp.
To the West to Route 9:
From Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center West Campus, turn right onto Brookline Avenue. Fol-
low Brookline Avenue for approximately 1 mile and then bear right onto Route 9 West.
To the South Shore to Route 3:
From Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center West Campus, turn left onto Brookline Avenue.
Cross over Longwood Avenue and continue through two sets of lights. At the third set of lights,
bear right onto Boylston Street.
Continue on Boylston Street and follow the signs for Storrow Drive eastbound. Once on
Storrow Drive follow signs for the Southeast Expressway.
At Leverett Circle go up the ramp and bear right. Follow the expressway until it merges with Route 3.
To the South to Route 24 and Interstate 95:
From Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center West Campus, turn left onto Brookline Avenue.
Cross over Longwood Avenue and continue through two sets of lights. At the third set of lights,
bear right onto Boylston Street.
Stay on Boylston Street and follow signs to Storrow Drive eastbound. Once on Storrow Drive follow
signs for the Southeast Expressway.
At Leverett Circle go up ramp and bear right merging onto the Southeast Expressway.
Follow the expressway and bear right onto Route 93. Follow Route 93 to Route 24 or to Route
Leaving Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center
EAST CAMPUS
330 Brookline Avenue, Boston, MA 02215
To the North to Interstate 93, 95, and US 1:
From Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center East Campus turn right onto Brookline Avenue and
follow until the second set of lights; bear right onto Boylston Street.
Stay on Boylston Street and follow signs to Storrow Drive eastbound. Once on Storrow Drive follow
signs for Route 93, 95, and Route 1 North.
At Leverett Circle go up ramp and bear left to Route 93 North.
On Route 93 bear left for Route 95 and Route 1 or proceed straight for Route 93.
To the Northwest to Route 2:
From Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center East Campus, turn right onto Brookline Avenue and
follow until the second set of lights; bear right onto Boylston Street.
Stay on Boylston Street and follow signs to Storrow Drive westbound. Stay on Storrow Drive and
follow the signs to Fresh Pond Parkway Route 2.
After crossing the Charles River, bear right and then left onto Fresh Pond Parkway. Follow Fresh
Pond Parkway to Route 2.
To the West to the Massachusetts Turnpike Extension:
From Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center East Campus, turn right onto Brookline Avenue.
At the second set of lights bear right onto Boylston Street. Continue on Boylston Street for four
sets of lights.
Bear right onto the downramp for Commonwealth Avenue. Off the downramp take a right onto
Commonwealth Avenue and stay in the right lane.
At the next set of lights, take a right onto Massachusetts Avenue and then a right onto the Massa-
chusetts Turnpike westbound ramp.
To the West to Route 9:
From Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center East Campus, turn left onto Brookline Avenue. Follow
Brookline Avenue for approximately 1 mile and then bear right onto Route 9 West.
To the South Shore to Route 3:
From Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center East Campus, turn right onto Brookline Avenue.
At the second set of lights, bear right onto Boylston Street.
Continue on Boylston Street and follow the signs for Storrow Drive eastbound. Once on Storrow
Drive follow signs for the Southeast Expressway.
At Leverett Circle go up the ramp and bear right. Follow the expressway until it merges with
Route 3.
To the South to Route 24 and Interstate 95:
From Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center East Campus, turn right onto Brookline Avenue.
At the second set of lights, bear right onto Boylston Street.
Stay on Boylston Street and follow signs to Storrow Drive eastbound. Once on Storrow Drive follow
signs for the Southeast Expressway.
At Leverett Circle go up ramp and bear right merging onto the Southeast Expressway.
Follow the expressway and bear right onto Route 93. Follow Route 93 to Route 24 or to
Route 95/128.
DRIVING DIRECTIONS
